question.problem: Which number corresponds to the midpoint of the line segment $\overset{―}{AB},$ if $A$ and $B$ are points on a number line that correspond to $-4$ and $2$, respectively?
question.worked_solution:
The point $A$ corresponds to the number ${x}_{1}=-4$ while $B$ corresponds to ${x}_{2}=2.$ 

To find the number ${x}_{m}$ corresponding to the midpoint $M$, we use the midpoint formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{m} & =\frac{{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-4+2}{2} \\  & =\frac{-2}{2} \\  & =-1\end{aligned}
$$
